title: DIALECTGEN: BENCHMARKING AND IMPROVING DIALECT ROBUSTNESS IN MULTIMODAL GENERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance degradation in text-to-image and text-to-video generative models by comparing outputs for Standard American English prompts against synonymous prompts containing lexical features from five other English dialects (African American, British, Chicano, Indian, and Singaporean English) using text-image alignment metrics like VQAScore, CLIPScore, and human evaluation.
